conceptZh: 豹身上有一圈圈的花紋
object: a rotund cartoon chef animal in a tall hat and a spotted leopard cub
morph: a chef's hat pops open and spots drop into 豹
creativeAngle: 胖廚師從帽子裡變出花豹，驚嚇後把斑點當點心；詞用「花豹」。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip teaching the Traditional Chinese character 豹 (leopard). Lead: a plump cartoon hippo chef with a tall white hat, tossing dough with confident but terrible aim. Moment 1 (0-1.6s): he flings a dough disc; it lands on his own hat; the voice says 豹 as he shakes his head and a pop sounds from the hat. Moment 2 (1.6-3.3s): spotted dough pieces fly from the hat and stick into strokes; on the second 豹 they snap into the glyph, the chef giving a double-take with his spatula. Moment 3 (3.3-5s): a golden leopard cub with black rosettes bursts out of the hat like a jack-in-the-box; as the voice says 花豹 the cub shakes, spots fly off like sprinkles and land back on the cub. Moment 4 (5-8s): glyph still; chef and cub share a donut, the chef's hat spinning slowly. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "豹、豹、花豹" (ㄅㄠˋ、ㄅㄠˋ、ㄏㄨㄚ ㄅㄠˋ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, then stops; no other speech, no music louder than the voice. The only on-screen text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 豹, drawn as saturated solid burnt orange strokes on a pale butter yellow background, correctly formed, centered, filling about 70% of frame height with margins, perfectly still for the final 3-second hold while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. No vocabulary text, subtitles, watermark, clutter, flashing, real people or realistic humans; bright but not neon, no dark grading.
